verdict.rationale: QuickBooks offers Intuit Intelligence chat that can answer natural-language financial questions and generate reports/forecasts from live ledger data (quickbooks-docs-19, quickbooks-docs-20, quickbooks-docs-29), and there's a documented official MCP server exposing 145 tools covering CRUD and financial reports via the QBO API (quickbooks-gh-3, quickbooks-gh-4, quickbooks-probe-3), which would let an external agent query live data. However, this is Intuit's own embedded assistant rather than a clearly demonstrated open agent-to-API pipeline answering affordability-style questions, and no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt was found (quickbooks-probe-1, quickbooks-probe-2), and no hands-on evidence confirms an external AI agent actually querying via MCP to answer a specific 'can we afford X' question. missing for 10: hands-on/independent evidence of an external agent using the API/MCP server to answer a cash-flow/affordability question, a discoverable OpenAPI/llms.txt spec, and confirmation the native Intuit Intelligence assistant handles this exact query type.
